name: GlassMagneticCursor

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: Nested OptimizedGlass inside OptimizedGlass with ignored intensity/blur props; default color rgba(255,255,255,0.24); mix-blend-difference. Contained preview is a static decorative dot next to a box (the certification shot shows only this static preview). OptimizedGlass (OptimizedGlassCore) only honors intent/elevation; intensity/blur/depth/tint/border and any glass* prop are stripped and ignored (src/primitives/OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:154-158,245-277).
motion: framer springs. Under reduced motion the style object is emptied (389-397), so the fixed cursor renders unpositioned at the top-left instead of being disabled. Trail/ripple ignore reduced motion.
a11y: Hides the system cursor (document.body.style.cursor='none') — hostile to low-vision users and breaks OS cursor settings; window 'mouseenter/mouseleave' never fire so restore relies on unmount. role/aria-label on an aria-hidden element. Haptic vibrate on every mousemove near a target.
api: forwardRef; many overlapping preview props (compact/contained/preview/density). GlassMagneticWrapper/useMagneticCursor not root-exported.
ssr: 'use client'. [data-magnetic] elements queried once on mount — dynamically added targets are ignored (134-151). setState (hover/target) on every mousemove; getBoundingClientRect in render (497-502).
fake_complexity: Magnetic pull is real but simple; the contained preview is a static mock.
justification: Global cursor replacement is an a11y anti-pattern for a design system; element-level magnetism already exists in GlassMagneticButton. The certification image is a static placeholder, not the effect.

name: GlassMeshGradient

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: 2D canvas radial gradients + CSS filter blur(100px) on the canvas, plus an injected per-instance <style> animated soft-light layer. Default palette is four whites (72-77) -> white-on-white; certification image is essentially colorless (colorfulness ~1.3, mean luminance 244). The glass in the story is provided by the story's inline backdropFilter, not the component.
motion: useAnimationFrame canvas loop + CSS keyframes. Reduced motion: loop returns before drawing anything, leaving a blank canvas (no static frame) (167-169). globalCompositeOperation/globalAlpha set after drawing and leak into next frame (233-239).
a11y: aria-label on a div without role (ignored by AT); canvas not aria-hidden.
api: Not forwardRef, no ref; colors default array literal in effect deps reseeds points on every parent render. useMeshGradientColors/adjustHue produce invalid colors (448-452). Presets use identical semantic colors (ocean = 4x primary).
ssr: 'use client'; canvas sized only on mount/window resize — no ResizeObserver, so a 0-size parent at mount yields a 0x0 canvas.
fake_complexity: Not a mesh gradient (no mesh/bilinear patches) — overlapping radial blobs.
justification: An ambient backdrop is genuinely useful behind glass (glass needs something to refract), but this one is colorless by default, blank under reduced motion, CPU-heavy (blur(100px) filter on a per-frame canvas) and duplicated by several atmospheric components. Rebuild as one tokenized, static-first ambient background with optional motion.

name: GlassMetaDashboard (GlassMetaEngine alias not root-exported)

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: glass-surface-primary glass-elev-5 utility classes; mixed raw Tailwind (fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50). Status dots hard-coded colors.
motion: framer; launcher with orbiting dots repeat:Infinity; panel uses initial={false} so no RM visibility bug here.
a11y: Floating launcher '◈' glyph with aria-label; panel role=dialog without focus management.
api: Provider/hook/dashboard; context default non-null so guard never fires.
ssr: GlassMetaEngineCore is constructed DURING RENDER (useRef init, 800-801) and its constructor starts three setIntervals that are never cleared (366-382) — on the server this leaks timers per request; on the client per mount.
fake_complexity: 'QuantumOptimizer' (random amplitudes, 'Schrödinger evolution'), 'self-healing neural network' with Math.random degradation; health issues are pushed on every metric without dedupe (unbounded); trend is computed after overwriting the score so is always 'stable' (424-430). When there is no data the dashboard shows HARD-CODED health 98%/100%/96% (905-911) — fabricated status presented as live.
justification: Fabricated 'system intelligence' (hard-coded health percentages, quantum/neural theater) with server-side interval leaks from render-time construction. Remove; real perf telemetry belongs in devtools, not the component package.

name: GlassNeuroMetricsDashboard

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: glass-surface-primary glass-elev-5 utilities; bar colors set via ref callbacks; emoji '🧠' launcher with animate-pulse.
motion: framer. Panel: Uses framer pattern initial={{opacity:0,...}} + animate={prefersReducedMotion ? {} : {...}}: under prefers-reduced-motion the element never leaves its initial (invisible/offset) state. (1017-1018). The certification screenshots (desktop and mobile) are BLANK: darkest pixel luminance 233 on both, i.e. no rendered text despite the DOM containing it — yet the certification entry lists zero issues.
a11y: role=dialog without focus mgmt; contained mode is still role=dialog; content invisible under reduced motion.
api: contained/defaultOpen props; showBrainwaves accepted and unused. Root does not export GlassNeuroSync wrapper.
fake_complexity: @demo header admits simulated EEG (8-10). connectDevice('muse'|'emotiv'|...) just sets isConnected=true without connecting to anything and reports '<type> Headset' as connected (656-669) — a false status. The simulator is also broken: EEGProcessor initializes buffers with Object.keys(Map) which is [] (129-131), so filteredBuffer.get(band) is undefined and buffer.push throws on the first sample; the ~2ms simulator setInterval (711) is never cleared.
justification: Pseudo-BCI with a crashing simulator, fake 'connected' state for real devices, and a certification screenshot that is literally blank. Remove.

name: GlassOrientationEffects

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: 'Refraction' is a flat rgba(255,255,255,.08) overlay and 'shimmer' a static gradient (390-395) — neither responds to orientation. Permission card className contains literal 'OptimizedGlass intensity={0.2} glassBlur={6}' (308).
motion: framer springs; prefersReducedMotion is read and NEVER used — tilt/parallax run for reduced-motion users.
a11y: On desktop Chromium 'DeviceOrientationEvent' in window is true, so isSupported=true and permissionGranted=false -> the component replaces its children with an 'Enable Device Orientation' card (304-335). Confirmed: the certification screenshot/text shows only that card, not the story's content. When tilt is enabled, children live in an absolute inset-0 layer so the container has no intrinsic height.
api: No forwardRef/style. effectTypes array default in callback deps. useDeviceOrientation hook never subscribes to events (448-476).
ssr: 'use client'; window accessed only in effects.
fake_complexity: Effect names (refraction, shimmer) do not do what they claim.
target: optional tilt option on a single interactive surface primitive
justification: Hides consumer content behind a permission prompt on ordinary desktops (visible in its own certification screenshot), ignores reduced motion, and its named effects are static overlays.

name: GlassParallaxLayers

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: Each layer is OptimizedGlass(intent neutral, elevation level1/level3) — shared primitive. But the depth-based blur ('glassBlur={finalBlur}') and depth/intensity props are stripped by OptimizedGlassCore, so the advertised depth-of-field blur never renders. OptimizedGlass (OptimizedGlassCore) only honors intent/elevation; intensity/blur/depth/tint/border and any glass* prop are stripped and ignored (src/primitives/OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:154-158,245-277).
motion: framer springs/useTransform; reduced motion honored (transforms zeroed, perspective none, listeners off) — the best RM handling in the shard. autoRotate uses setState every 16ms instead of a motion value.
a11y: Container role=presentation and aria-hidden when no aria-label is supplied (198-200) — real layer content is hidden from assistive tech by default. 'Hover to interact' hint is a live region that changes on hover.
api: forwardRef with merged ref (good). Calls useTransform x5 INSIDE layers.map (202-250) — rules-of-hooks violation; changing the number of layers between renders crashes. layers.content API is awkward; presets have content:null.
ssr: 'use client'; window access only in effects; rAF-throttled scroll.
fake_complexity: Parallax is real; depth blur is not (props ignored).
justification: The concept (stacked glass planes at depth) is on-brand and the motion/reduced-motion work is decent, but hooks-in-loop, aria-hidden-by-default, and the silently ignored depth blur mean it does not deliver its premise. Rebuild with a per-layer child component (hooks legal), real per-depth blur tokens, and content-visible semantics.

name: GlassParticles

tests.nature: Templated boilerplate test (smoke render, jest-axe on initial render, className passthrough, snapshot); no behavioral/reduced-motion/keyboard assertions.

material_impl: Canvas hard-paints an opaque near-black field rgb(6,8,14) with cyan/ice radial gradients every frame (434-464) and the wrapper background is a dark gradient (565-566) — theme-agnostic, ignores tokens. Default particle colors are dark slate rgba(15,23,42,.62) on that near-black field (82-86) -> near-invisible by default. OptimizedGlass sheen at opacity 0.08 and zIndex -1 (583-590) is effectively decorative. Certification screenshot is near-white (mean luminance 244) with no dark field visible, i.e. the canvas did not paint at its laid-out size.
motion: useAnimationFrame; reduced motion draws a static frame (548-557) — correct intent.
a11y: role=presentation + aria-label (ignored); aria-hidden unless labeled (fine for decoration).
api: forwardRef; overlapping compact/contained/preview props; colorScheme 'rainbow' returns slate gray (271-272) — name lies; colors default array literal in deps.
ssr: 'use client'. O(n^2) connection pass per frame; mouse repulsion divides by distance without zero guard (391-394); canvas sized from parent only on mount/window resize (no ResizeObserver).
fake_complexity: Particles are real; 'glass' aspect is nominal.
justification: One of four particle systems; hard-coded dark canvas defeats theming, defaults are invisible, and the certification capture shows no particle field. Merge the reduced-motion static-frame logic into a single tokenized particle background.
